title: get_mouse_position in SubViewport returns incorrect values
body: ### Tested versions -Reproducible in Godot_v4.5.1-stable_win64 ### System information Windows 10 ### Issue description - Create 2D-Scene in godot engine inside a Subviewport - Create godot script on a node inside the Subviewport - get_viewport().get_mouse_position() returns always zero-vector, unless it is called on a note outside of the Subviewport. In the second case the value of mouse-position is wrong ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create a 2d Scene view Subviewport. For easier handling SubViewport and Window have the same size. 2. The node DebugLineDraw draws via draw_line different mouse positions 4. **PROBLEM**: If we use get_viewport().get_mouse_position() in the DebugLineDraw-Node, we will always get the Zero-Vector 5. If we use get_viewport().get_mouse_position() on the Root-Node we seem to get the correct SubViewport (we can verify this by printing get_visible_rect().size of the Viewport) 6. The Mouse position we get in step 5 still seems to be wrong. The Demo app draws the correct mouse position with a green cross, and the mouse position we get in step 5 with a red cross 7. To fix the mouse position we need to add the camera offset, rotation and zoom to the values we get in step 5 According the the Docu get_mouse_position should: "Returns the mouse's position in this Viewport using the coordinate system of this Viewport.". I would assume this includes SubViewports and the corresponding camera inside the SubViewports. The minimal example code for the screenshots above is attached. For further testing the camera in the example can be moved with WADS, rotated with QE and zoomed with mousewheel. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Minimum example [deferredrendering.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24554527/deferredrendering.zip)
